bullion_banks.bull_trend: Warehouse trend-following demand and manage forward inventory.
bullion_banks.crisis_dislocation: Funding and basis stress make them critical relays.
bullion_banks.macro_transition: Translate macro repricing into forward/spot market structure.
bullion_banks.range_compression: Optimize balance sheet rather than directional expression.

central_banks.bear_unwind: Higher real-rate pressure dominates reserve demand.
central_banks.bull_trend: Policy stance matters less than persistent investor and CTA trend reinforcement.
central_banks.calm_carry: Steady policy backdrop suppresses urgent gold demand.
central_banks.crisis_dislocation: Policy and reserve credibility become central network anchors.
central_banks.range_compression: Policy uncertainty is low and participant interactions are muted.

commercial_hedgers.bear_unwind: Reduce hedges or monetize prior protection.
commercial_hedgers.bull_trend: Increase tactical hedging as upside persists.
commercial_hedgers.calm_carry: Optimize carry and financing through forward structures.
commercial_hedgers.macro_transition: Re-evaluate hedge structures as macro carry changes.
commercial_hedgers.range_compression: Maintain baseline hedges with little directional urgency.

ctas.bear_unwind: Reverse long exposure and accelerate unwind.
ctas.bull_trend: Scale into trend continuation and amplify directional persistence.
ctas.calm_carry: Lower participation because trends are muted.
ctas.crisis_dislocation: Can reinforce both crash and rebound once trend rules trigger.
ctas.macro_transition: Join after directional persistence is established.
ctas.range_compression: Low engagement because breakout signals are absent.

dealers.bull_trend: Distribute directional client demand while protecting inventory.
dealers.crisis_dislocation: Become bottlenecks as balance-sheet capacity shrinks.
dealers.macro_transition: Intermediate rapid portfolio reallocation across participants.

etf_investors.calm_carry: Strategic flows dominate over tactical changes.
etf_investors.crisis_dislocation: Add to safe-haven positions after stress confirmation.
etf_investors.macro_transition: Respond after thesis gains institutional legitimacy.

macro_hedge_funds.bear_unwind: Rotate toward USD/rates expressions over gold.
macro_hedge_funds.bull_trend: Express pro-gold macro thesis via cross-asset allocations.
macro_hedge_funds.crisis_dislocation: Aggressively reallocate across gold, USD, and rates.
macro_hedge_funds.macro_transition: Fastest tactical reallocators at narrative turning points.

market_makers.bear_unwind: Tighten risk, manage adverse flow imbalances.
market_makers.bull_trend: Provide liquidity but shorten quote horizons.
market_makers.crisis_dislocation: Withdraw liquidity and widen spreads sharply.
market_makers.macro_transition: Adjust depth as information arrival accelerates.
market_makers.range_compression: Dominate microstructure with deepest continuous liquidity.

retail_traders.crisis_dislocation: Chase fear-driven moves late in the cycle.
retail_traders.range_compression: Fade visibility due to low excitement.

safe_haven_capital_flows.bull_trend: Less dominant unless trend is fear-driven.
safe_haven_capital_flows.crisis_dislocation: Most dominant participant during systemic stress.
safe_haven_capital_flows.macro_transition: Rise when macro transition overlaps with systemic fear.
